promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: Geometry authority: exact silhouettes, layout, placement and scale; flat colours are placeholders, not material
Image 2: Livery, palette and wear reference only; not layout, subject or scale
Image 3: Rendering style and detail level only; not layout, palette or subject

Paint image 1, a flat-colour geometry guide, as a sheet of four finished top-down game sprites of a CONTROL NODE of an abandoned Tri-Tachyon black site whose automated defences are still carrying out an executive contingency order: the armoured, unarmed relay and controller structure of one security zone, about three metres across, standing against a wall, that relays alarms, directs the zone's drones and walkers and keeps its repair drones working. It carries no weapons. The four are alternative designs; keep each exactly where the guide puts it, at exactly its size and outline:
- top-left, MAST: a square armoured cabinet with caution-striped corners, a relay mast with a small dish antenna on top, a cable junction panel.
- top-right, PYLON: an octagonal armoured pillar with a recessed sensor dome at its centre and a ring of status lamps.
- bottom-left, CABINET: a bank of three armoured relay cabinets with louvred doors, heat-sink fins down both sides, a status lamp on each door.
- bottom-right, BUNKER: a low rounded armoured dome with two stubby antenna sockets, a small sensor lens and an armoured cable trunk running out of one side.
Livery and material: Tri-Tachyon high-tech, seamless composite shells and sealed panels in white and pale grey with graphite seams, but GONE DULL after decades unattended: yellowed, dust-greyed and scorched white, cracked panels, cyan status lights faded to a weak glow; where the guide has yellow put a thin dull cyan accent band, where it has red put a dim cyan sensor lens; smooth and sealed, nothing exposed. Image 2 is a structure of the same network in this livery (livery, palette and wear reference only, not layout or subject); this must read as the same family. Match the rendering scale and level of detail of image 3, an approved top-down structure sprite from this game (rendering style and detail only, not layout, palette or subject): grounded, believable, crisp and readable at small size, not glossy concept art.
In the guide pale grey is armour plate, mid grey is seams, panels or the cable trunk, dark is vents, sockets or recesses, red a status lamp or lens, yellow caution striping.
Strict 90-degree overhead orthographic view, no perspective tilt, lit from the upper left. Keep each drawing exactly where the guide puts it, at exactly its size, position and outline; never move, rotate, rescale or recompose anything, and add nothing between them. True transparent background with genuine alpha outside the silhouettes; no ground, scene, cast-shadow slab, labels, text, border, grid or checkerboard. Same square canvas as the guide.
